description: Defines the data model for a Note entity and its synchronization status, including an enum for sync states and a class with properties such as id, title, content, timestamps, deletion flag, and sync status.

classes.name: SyncStatus
classes.description: Enumeration representing different synchronization states of a note, such as clean, dirty, syncing, and failed.

classes.name: Note
classes.description: Class representing a note entity with properties like id, title, content, timestamps, deletion status, and synchronization status, including a copyWith method for creating modified copies.

methods.name: copyWith
methods.description: Creates a new instance of Note with the specified properties modified, supporting immutability and easy updates.
